title: Molecular Assembly and Magnetic Dynamics of Two Novel Dy6 and Dy8 Aggregates

material_class.structural_family: triangular-prism Dy6 with three Dy2 petals linked by two carbonato ligands

synthesis.procedure: A suspension of DyCl3·6H2O (0.2 mmol, 75.4 mg) and H2ovph (54.2 mg, 0.2 mmol) in MeOH/CH3CN (5 mL/10 mL) was treated with Et3N (1.0 mmol, 0.14 mL). CO2 was then bubbled into the reaction mixture for 30 s; the suspension gradually became a clear solution, which was stirred for 6 h and left undisturbed for slow solvent evaporation. Yellow block-shaped single crystals of 2 suitable for X-ray diffraction formed after 1 week.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution reaction with CO2 bubbling, then slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: left undisturbed for slow evaporation; yellow block crystals of 2 after 1 week
synthesis.yield: 23 mg (23.1% based on the metal salt)

properties.summary: Dy6 SMM: dc χMT at 300 K is 82.1 cm3 K mol−1 (expected 85.02 for six uncoupled DyIII); χMT shows a small maximum (75.3 cm3 K mol−1 at 6 K) attributed to intramolecular ferromagnetic interaction, then a rapid low-T drop. Magnetization does not saturate at high field (>60 kOe, 1.9 K). Zero-field ac data show frequency-dependent χ″ (maximum at 15 K for 1000 Hz). Arrhenius fit of τ at 11–20 K gives Ueff = 76 K and τ0 = 1.2×10−6 s; below ~10 K quantum tunneling dominates and τ reaches 0.2 s near 1.9 K. Cole–Cole plots are symmetrical with α from 0.1 (16 K) to 0.23 (1.9 K), consistent with a single relaxation process.

measurements.conditions: zero dc field, Arrhenius fit 11–20 K

material_class.structural_family: octanuclear Dy8 tub conformation with Dy(ovph) fragments on a carbonato core

synthesis.procedure: Prepared analogously to 2 but using Na2CO3·10H2O instead of CO2. A suspension of DyCl3·6H2O (0.2 mmol, 75.4 mg) and H2ovph (54.2 mg, 0.2 mmol) in MeOH/CH3CN (5 mL/10 mL) was treated with Et3N (1.0 mmol, 0.14 mL). Na2CO3·10H2O (85.8 mg, 0.3 mmol) was added, the mixture was stirred for 6 h and filtered, and the yellow filtrate was left undisturbed for slow evaporation. Red block-shaped single crystals of 3 suitable for X-ray diffraction formed after 1 month.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered; yellow filtrate left for slow evaporation; red block crystals of 3 after 1 month
synthesis.yield: 58 mg (52% based on the metal salt)

properties.summary: Possible Dy8 SMM with a small relaxation barrier. dc χMT at room temperature is 107.4 cm3 K mol−1 (expected 113.4 for eight uncoupled DyIII), remaining roughly constant to 100 K then falling to 82.6 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K. Reduced magnetization M vs H/T curves (1.9–4 K, 10–70 kOe) do not superimpose, indicating anisotropy. Zero-field ac χ″ is frequency-dependent below 15 K down to 1.9 K without peaks (χ″/χ′ ≈ 1:4 at 1.9 K, 1500 Hz). Applied dc fields of 50–200 Oe have little effect on the ac profile, suggesting zero-field tunneling is not efficient above 1.9 K.
